scientific_integrity: Exact symbolic proof of the full attracting-basin depth polynomial, including unique Hensel lifts, valuation doubling, and counting all shells; independent finite-modulus traversal verification in verify.py.
scientific_limitations: For arbitrary odd primes this only counts the attracting basin of 0<->-1, not other periodic components. Full-ring census is asserted only for primes 3 and 7. General p-adic lifting theory is prior work; unlocated equivalent exact formulas remain an originality risk.
title: Exact prime-power attraction-depth transfer for the quadratic critical two-cycle
